sentences.en: I have four fingers on one hand.
There are five apples on the table.
An eight-sided shape is an octagon.
A number is a sign for a value.
I count the books on the shelf.
The first day of the week is Sunday.
sentences.zh: 一周的第一天是星期天。

sentences.en: She is the second child in the family.
sentences.zh: 她是家里的第二个孩子。

sentences.en: A half of the apple is for you.
A part of the cake is gone.
We measure the length of the table.
The division of the cake into four parts was fair.
sentences.zh: 把蛋糕分成四份是公平的。

sentences.en: The distribution of food to everyone was equal.
sentences.zh: 食物分配给每个人是相等的。

sentences.en: The degree of heat in summer is high.
